messages.text:
Hey Allie! Any chance you'd host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I'd love it.

One favour: could you invite Jordan yourself and not mention me in it? Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel like the whole thing is about me.

No pressure if Saturday doesn't work — just tell me and we'll find another day.

Hey Sarah — yes, let's do it. Saturday at 3:30 at my place works, I'd be glad to host.

I'll invite Jordan myself and won't mention you in it, no problem at all. See you Saturday.
Hey Jordan! I'm having a little get-together at my place this Saturday, around 3:30 — would you like to come? Nothing formal, just people and food. Let me know if you can make it.
Perfect, thank you — see you Saturday at 3:30. I owe you one.
See you Saturday, Sarah. No debts — it'll be fun.

Hey Allie! Sounds great — I'd love to come. My study session ends at 3:30 on Saturday, so I'll head over right after and be there a bit past 3:30. I have dinner with my family at 6, so I'll need to leave by then. See you Saturday!
Great, glad you're coming! Come straight from your study session, no rush — we'll still be going. Good to know about 6, I'll plan food early so you get fed before you head out. See you Saturday.
Perfect, thanks Allie — see you Saturday!
